segs.utf8: Welcome to this short video about honeybees.
Today we look at how bees tell each other where flowers are.
The forager comes home and dances a figure of eight on the comb.
The straight part of the dance points toward the food, measured from the sun.
The longer the waggle lasts, the farther away the flowers are.
Other bees follow the dancer and then fly out to the food.
